posts.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: RCE CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 Actively Exploited as Zero-Days
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on internet-facing edge appliances via network access.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Citrix NetScaler ADC
- Citrix NetScaler Gateway
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Attack Chain:** CVE-2026-88771 allows unauthenticated command execution on all deployments; CVE-2026-88772 enables RCE/DoS. Both independently exploited.
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to internet-facing NetScaler appliance; CVE-2026-88771 requires no extra features, CVE-2026-88772 requires DTLS enabled (default for VPN virtual servers).
- **Impact Details:** Patching alone may not remove attacker access gained pre-patch. Preserve forensic evidence before updating.
- **Available Mitigations:**   
 Vendor patches available; install as soon as possible.
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway 14.1-73.37 and later releases
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway 13.1-64.23 and later releases of 13.1
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC 14.1-FIPS 14.1-73.37 FIPS and later releases of 14.1-FIPS
    - Citrix NetScaler ADC 13.1-FIPS and 13.1-NDcPP 13.1.37.279 and later releases of 13.1-FIPS and 13.1-NDcPP

    - **Temporary:** implement broad geo IP restrictions.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-88771 CVSS4.0: 9.5 (CRITICAL) - Improper input validation enabling unauthenticated RCE; affects all deployments (actively exploited)
- CVE-2026-88772 CVSS4.0: 9.5 (CRITICAL) - Memory overflow leading to RCE/DoS on DTLS-enabled appliances (actively exploited)

Primary:

posts.title: [Advisory] Fortinet FortiMail: Path Traversal Exploited in Zero-Day Attacks (CVE-2026-104286)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files and execute unauthorized code or commands via network access.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Fortinet FortiMail
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to the FortiMail management interface; no authentication required.
- **Impact Details:** Observed attacks deploy malicious binaries and modified system files (e.g., ld.so.preload, webconsole, mailservice), indicating post-exploitation persistence and code execution.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor will be available in upcoming releases; upgrade to a fixed version as soon as possible.
    - **Temporary:** 
      - Disable the IBE feature support using the following CLI command following vendor guidance.
      - Alternatively: Disable access to the FortiMail management interface from the internet or limit the access only from trusted private network

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-104286 (CRITICAL) - Unauthenticated path traversal enabling arbitrary file write and code execution

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-26-175

Supporting:

posts.title: [Advisory] Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: API Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-76504)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to gain admin-level API access remotely.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (all configurations)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Attack Chain:** Improper URI encoding handling allows a crafted HTTP request (e.g., using an encoded character such as `%6a` in `j_security_check` as `/%6a_security_check`) to bypass authentication rules and access the API as admin (not limited to the  `%6a` -> `j` character) .
- **Prerequisites:** Network/remote access to the affected system's API; no authentication required.
- **Impact Details:** Attacker gains admin privileges; IOCs include suspiciously encoded `j_security_check` entries for `viptela-reserved-` accounts in service-proxy and vmanage-server logs.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor software updates available
    - Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Cloud Hosted environments already remediated
    - **additionaly :** Follow Cisco Hardening recommendations

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-76504 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - URI encoding authentication bypass granting admin API access

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory (including IoCs and Hardening recommendations): https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-sdwan-webauth-xr8beuuU

Supporting:
- Additional Sources: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/resources/Cisco-Catalyst-SD-WAN-HardeningGuide (Generic Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Hardening Guide)

posts.title: [Advisory] Adobe August 2026 security updates fixed Critical vulnerabilities in ColdFusion, Campaign Classic & Commerce
posts.content:

- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

- Adobe ColdFusion
- Adobe Campaign Classic (on-premise and hybrid deployments)
- Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce B2B
- For specific versions, please check the references.

- **Prerequisites:** Network access; most critical flaws require no authentication or user interaction.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches available

- CVE-2026-71398 CVSS3.1: 10.0 (CRITICAL) - Campaign Classic incorrect authorization enabling RCE

posts.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Check Point's Security Management Server that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary scripts on the server. The flaw stems from a path traversal bug in the management server's web service. Threat actors have already actively exploited this zero-day vulnerability in targeted attacks.
